english: On coming to know of a fierce fight between the Lord and the Dānava, sage Nārada became highly delighted in his soul. He began to dance saying, “I am blessed today. Leaving them aside the Brāhmaṇa Nārada came to the place where Maheśvara, the Lord, was present.
